entry_state: The historical record now separates immutable assertions, derived amounts, mappings, clocks, company boundaries and three coverage meanings. Explicit selection and review procedures distinguish extraction, translation, model admission and accounting eligibility. The next passage begins the actual conflicting JPMorgan reference and its correction consequences.
exit_state: A faithfully copied wrong reference now has distinct literal, navigation and invalidation outcomes. Coverage, rounding assumptions and public/system information views are explicit. The bank and treaty examples separate underlying event order from knowledge of it; the final dependency discussion is still completing its distinction between revised explanations and committed events.
findings: The JPMorgan example directly calls the156 navigation target wrong while retaining faithful transcription of156. A refuted target is rejected rather than preserved as an equally admissible alternative.

The source correction invalidates dependent page selections, negative searches and coverage results, not every independently sourced amount. Expected review actions are not presented as observed human decisions.
The precision formula is a conservative enclosure under an admitted nearest-rounding model. Truncation and unknown rounding remain different cases; the source scale alone imposes no half-unit bound.

The date-only timeline distinguishes excluded, unresolved and date-supported admission. Public bytes, system possession and accepted review have separate dates; later ingestion need not defeat an earlier investor-information query.

The treaty-order correction preserves the original view and distinguishes known-late from unknown-availability competitors. Candidate-set membership and complete ancestry matter even when a chosen identifier or displayed amount stays unchanged.
No new confirmed defect. The final sector-revision subsection and chapter remain pending because page72 ends mid-argument.
